title: Spark Resistance Parts Matrix
description: Whole-matrix prediction: the learner sets 18 cells (six centrifugal fan components by spark-resistant Types A, B and C) to Non-ferrous, Steel or Not listed, checks them against FanPedia's component lists, sees each wrong row's reason, may fix the wrong cells once, and gets the full answer table and note.

educational.audience: Adult professional development: new application engineers, sales staff, representatives and facilities staff
educational.topic: Spark resistant construction Types A, B and C on centrifugal fans
learningObjectives: The learner will differentiate spark-resistant Types A, B and C on a centrifugal fan by predicting, for six fan components, whether each type makes the component non-ferrous, leaves it steel, or does not list it, with at least 15 of 18 cells correct on the first attempt.

accessibility.notes: Native table with row and column headers; every cell is a labelled <select> ("Impeller, Type C"); the verdict is added to each cell's label after Check; verdicts announced through FP.announce (aria-live); ✓/✗ text and solid/dashed borders pair with colour; component descriptions open from keyboard-reachable buttons with aria-expanded; text never below 12 px.

controls.label: 18 matrix cells
controls.purpose: Set each component/type cell to Non-ferrous, Steel or Not listed

controls.label: Check
controls.purpose: Score the matrix; available only when all 18 cells are set

controls.label: Try Again
controls.purpose: Clear only the wrong cells for a second, unscored Check

controls.label: Show Answers
controls.purpose: Reveal the answer table, every reason and the note

controls.label: Start over
controls.purpose: Clear the matrix and the score

rules: Each cell has exactly one correct state from the answer table (FanPedia pp. 104-106).
All cells start empty; Check is available only when all 18 are set.
Score = cells matching the answer table on the first Check; mastery 15 of 18.
Try Again clears only the incorrect cells; the second Check is not scored.
Answers, reasons and the note are revealed after the second Check or on Show Answers.
assumptions: Centrifugal fans only; axial, radial bladed and pressure blower Type C parts differ (FanPedia pp. 107-109).
limitations: Six representative components; FanPedia's lists include further parts such as set screws and shaft seals.

sources: FanPedia: The Fan & Blower Encyclopedia (Twin City Fan), Spark Resistant Construction, Centrifugal Fans, pp. 104-106, https://tcf.com/fanpedia/

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Commit a prediction for every cell, check the whole matrix at once, read the reason for each wrong row, then repair
keyQuestions: Which parts does each type make non-ferrous?
Why does Type A's list have no rub plate?
Which two rows carry the main difference between Types B and C?
commonMisconceptions: Type C makes the impeller non-ferrous.
Type B makes the whole airstream non-ferrous.
Spark-resistant construction makes the shaft non-ferrous.
assessmentOpportunities: First-Check score shown as 'First Check: n of 18 cells (recorded)'; mastery is 15 of 18 on the first Check.
